chunks: Ibn Mahboub, from Hanaan and Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Zurara, who said:

I said to him: The Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: 'I will certainly lie in wait for them on Your straight path. Then I will certainly come to them from before them and from behind them, and from their right and from their left; and You will not find most of them thankful.'
He said, so Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'O Zurara! Indeed, he (Satan) only lay in wait for you and your companions. As for the others, he has finished with them.'
ai.seo_question: Why did Satan specifically target the companions of the Prophet and the Imams?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) clarifies that Satan's specific vow to 'block the straight path' (Surah Al-A'raf 16-17) is primarily directed at the Ahl al-Bayt and their devoted companions, who are the true exemplars of the path. For the general populace, Satan's influence is considered largely concluded or less potent, whereas for the righteous few, he remains an active, persistent adversary. This highlights the unique spiritual status of the Imams and their followers, who face a more intense, targeted struggle against Shaytan.

en.hubeali: H 14566 – Ibn Mahboub, from Hanaan and Ali Bin Ra’ib, from Zurara who said:

I said to himasws, ‘The Statement of the Mighty and Majestic: “[7:16] I will certainly lie in wait for them in Thy straight path [7:17] Then I will certainly come to them from before them and from behind them, and from their right-hand side and from their left-hand side; and Thou shalt not find most of them thankful”
, so Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Zurara! But rather, he (Satan<sup>la</sup>) is lying in wait for you and for your companions. So as for the other ones, he has finished from them’.
